via_in_pad.not_chosen: Keeping the in-pad holes with JLCPCB "Epoxy Filled & Capped" (POFV): rejected by the owner (an order option with its own surcharge on 4-layer boards). Ordering the in-pad holes open: rejected (solder wicking). Copper-only pad extensions with holes outside the paste but inside pad copper: rejected, a hole would still sit in pad copper
via_in_pad.order: Standard JLCPCB order, nothing exotic: Via Covering = "Tented" (the default); no "Epoxy Filled & Capped" / POFV option and no via-in-pad remark; minimum via 0.3/0.6 mm (no small-hole surcharge); 4 layers, JLC04161H-7628, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner. Pre-order checklist: confirm U4, U5 and U9 are the *_NoViaInPad footprints with no plated hole in their pads, that every via in the drill file is 0.3 mm and that no hole is below 0.3 mm
via_in_pad.replacement: beside-pad thermal fields (THERMAL_VIA_FIELDS): one row of standard vias beyond each short end of the exposed pad (ring 0.15 mm from the pad copper, 0.6 mm pitch), each via with its own 0.6 mm F.Cu spoke into the pad copper, and a B.Cu landing pour of the pad net under the part; U5 10 vias (was 15 in the pad), U4 10 (was 8), U9 6 (was 4 x 0.2 mm). C2, R24/C3 and R13/R14/R15 moved 0.45 / 0.45 / 0.25 mm to make room. The long sides have no room (pin rows 0.375-0.5 mm from the pad copper)
via_in_pad.why: Owner decision: a via in a pad needs a fill/cap order option or wicks solder down the barrel (exposed-pad voids, lifted parts); standard tented vias beside the pad need neither and pass JLCPCB standard DFM. The cost is a longer heat path: the heat now crosses the outer copper from the solder window to the via rows (calcs.json thermal_contract.via_change: U5 +DeltaR and Tj at the rated 3 A input against 125 C, U2 unchanged because its pads were never drilled, U4/U9 DeltaR recorded)

via_spec.jlc: JLCPCB standard multilayer process: 0.3/0.6 mm is above the 0.2 mm preferred minimum hole and carries no small-via surcharge (0.2-0.25 mm holes with < 0.45 mm pads, and 0.1-0.15 mm holes, cost more); via hole-to-hole >= 0.2 mm; average hole plating 18 um; Via Covering "Tented" is the default order option. Source: https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities (read 2026-11-02)
